answer: Cap each epoch of new seats and fill them by an all-pay sealed-bid auction: every applicant burns its bid whether or not it wins. The comforting fable of free identity breaks here, no ivory-tower exemption. A lone honest agent bids once near the clearing price, but an attacker seeking N seats must win N of the scarce slots, outbidding real demand and forfeiting every losing bid too. Each clone is one more non-refundable payment on a thread of rising clearing prices, so faking a crowd costs N times the price and climbs super-linearly as the attacker bids against itself.
